chapter.name: Akshara Brahma Yoga
chapter.description: Krishna explains the concepts of Brahman, the nature of the self, karma, and the importance of remembering the divine at the time of death. This chapter focuses on how one’s final thoughts determine their next state and emphasizes constant remembrance of God.
chapter.theme: Understanding the eternal Brahman, remembrance of God, and liberation at the time of death
chapter.yogaType: Akshara Brahma Yoga - Yoga of the Imperishable Reality

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच | किं तद्ब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम | अधिभूतं च किं प्रोक्तमधिदैवं किमुच्यते ||
verses.transliteration: arjuna uvāca | kiṃ tad brahma kim adhyātmaṃ kiṃ karma puruṣottama | adhibhūtaṃ ca kiṃ proktam adhidaivaṃ kim ucyate ||
verses.english_translation: Arjuna said: What is Brahman? What is the self? What is karma? What is called the material world and the divine principle?
verses.meaning: Arjuna asks about fundamental spiritual concepts.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: अधियज्ञः कथं कोऽत्र देहेऽस्मिन्मधुसूदन | प्रयाणकाले च कथं ज्ञेयोऽसि नियतात्मभिः ||
verses.transliteration: adhiyajñaḥ kathaṃ ko 'tra dehe 'smin madhusūdana | prayāṇa-kāle ca kathaṃ jñeyo 'si niyatātmabhiḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Who is the lord of sacrifice, and how is He present in the body? How can one know You at the time of death?
verses.meaning: Arjuna seeks clarity on spiritual realization at death.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच | अक्षरं ब्रह्म परमं स्वभावोऽध्यात्ममुच्यते | भूतभावोद्भवकरो विसर्गः कर्मसंज्ञितः ||
verses.transliteration: śrī-bhagavān uvāca | akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ svabhāvo 'dhyātmam ucyate | bhūta-bhāvodbhava-karo visargaḥ karma-saṃjñitaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: The Blessed Lord said: Brahman is the imperishable, the self is one's nature, and karma is the force that causes creation.
verses.meaning: Krishna defines core spiritual concepts.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अधिभूतं क्षरो भावः पुरुषश्चाधिदैवतम् | अधियज्ञोऽहमेवात्र देहे देहभृतां वर ||
verses.transliteration: adhibhūtaṃ kṣaro bhāvaḥ puruṣaś cādhidaivatam | adhiyajño 'ham evātra dehe deha-bhṛtāṃ vara ||
verses.english_translation: The material world is perishable, the divine is the cosmic being, and I am the sacrifice within the body.
verses.meaning: Krishna explains the roles of different aspects of existence.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेवरम् | यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः ||
verses.transliteration: anta-kāle ca mām eva smaran muktvā kalevaram | yaḥ prayāti sa mad-bhāvaṃ yāti nāsty atra saṃśayaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Whoever remembers Me at death attains My nature without doubt.
verses.meaning: Final remembrance determines spiritual destination.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम् | तं तमेवैति कौन्तेय सदा तद्भावभावितः ||
verses.transliteration: yaṃ yaṃ vāpi smaran bhāvaṃ tyajaty ante kalevaram | taṃ tam evaiti kaunteya sadā tad-bhāva-bhāvitaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Whatever one remembers at death, that state they attain.
verses.meaning: Thoughts at death reflect lifelong focus.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च | मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयम् ||
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sarveṣu kāleṣu mām anusmara yudhya ca | mayy arpita-mano-buddhir mām evaiṣyasy asaṃśayam ||
verses.english_translation: Therefore, always remember Me and perform your duty; you will surely reach Me.
verses.meaning: Balance devotion with action.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना | परमं पुरुषं दिव्यं याति पार्थानुचिन्तयन् ||
verses.transliteration: abhyāsa-yoga-yuktena cetasā nānya-gāminā | paramaṃ puruṣaṃ divyaṃ yāti pārthānucintayan ||
verses.english_translation: Through constant practice and focus, one reaches the supreme divine person.
verses.meaning: Practice and concentration lead to realization.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: कविं पुराणमनुशासितारमणोरणीयांसमनुस्मरेद्यः | सर्वस्य धातारमचिन्त्यरूपमादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात् ||
verses.transliteration: kaviṃ purāṇam anuśāsitāram aṇor aṇīyāṃsam anusmared yaḥ | sarvasya dhātāram acintya-rūpam āditya-varṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt ||
verses.english_translation: Meditate on the omniscient, ancient, supreme being who is beyond darkness.
verses.meaning: Focus on the divine beyond material limitations.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: प्रयाणकाले मनसाचलेन भक्त्या युक्तो योगबलेन चैव | भ्रुवोर्मध्ये प्राणमावेश्य सम्यक् स तं परं पुरुषमुपैति दिव्यम् ||
verses.transliteration: prayāṇa-kāle manasācalena bhaktyā yukto yoga-balena caiva | bhruvor madhye prāṇam āveśya samyak sa taṃ paraṃ puruṣam upaiti divyam ||
verses.english_translation: At death, one who concentrates with devotion attains the supreme being.
verses.meaning: Focused devotion at death leads to liberation.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यदक्षरं वेदविदो वदन्ति विशन्ति यद्यतयो वीतरागाः | यदिच्छन्तो ब्रह्मचर्यं चरन्ति तत्ते पदं सङ्ग्रहेण प्रवक्ष्ये ||
verses.transliteration: yad akṣaraṃ veda-vido vadanti viśanti yad yatayo vīta-rāgāḥ | yad icchanto brahmacaryaṃ caranti tat te padaṃ saṅgraheṇa pravakṣye ||
verses.english_translation: I will explain the imperishable state that seekers strive to attain.
verses.meaning: Krishna describes the ultimate spiritual goal.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च | मूर्ध्न्याधायात्मनः प्राणमास्थितो योगधारणाम् ||
verses.transliteration: sarva-dvārāṇi saṃyamya mano hṛdi nirudhya ca | mūrdhny ādhāyātmanaḥ prāṇam āsthito yoga-dhāraṇām ||
verses.english_translation: Controlling all senses and fixing the mind, one practices deep meditation.
verses.meaning: Discipline is essential for spiritual practice.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन्मामनुस्मरन् | यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम् ||
verses.transliteration: om ity ekākṣaraṃ brahma vyāharan mām anusmaran | yaḥ prayāti tyajan dehaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||
verses.english_translation: One who chants Om and remembers Me at death attains the supreme goal.
verses.meaning: Sacred sound and remembrance lead to liberation.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः | तस्याहं सुलभः पार्थ नित्ययुक्तस्य योगिनः ||
verses.transliteration: ananya-cetāḥ satataṃ yo māṃ smarati nityaśaḥ | tasyāhaṃ sulabhaḥ pārtha nitya-yuktasya yoginaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: One who always remembers Me with devotion easily attains Me.
verses.meaning: Constant devotion brings closeness to the divine.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: मामुपेत्य पुनर्जन्म दुःखालयमशाश्वतम् | नाप्नुवन्ति महात्मानः संसिद्धिं परमां गताः ||
verses.transliteration: mām upetya punar janma duḥkhālayam aśāśvatam | nāpnuvanti mahātmānaḥ saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Great souls who attain Me are freed from the cycle of birth and suffering.
verses.meaning: Liberation ends the cycle of rebirth.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: आब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोकाः पुनरावर्तिनोऽर्जुन | मामुपेत्य तु कौन्तेय पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते ||
verses.transliteration: ā-brahma-bhuvanāl lokāḥ punar āvartino 'rjuna | mām upetya tu kaunteya punar janma na vidyate ||
verses.english_translation: All worlds up to Brahma's realm are subject to rebirth, but one who attains Me is never reborn.
verses.meaning: Only realization of the divine leads to liberation from rebirth.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तमहर्यद्ब्रह्मणो विदुः | रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां तेऽहोरात्रविदो जनाः ||
verses.transliteration: sahasra-yuga-paryantam ahar yad brahmaṇo viduḥ | rātriṃ yuga-sahasrāntāṃ te 'ho-rātra-vido janāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Those who know cosmic time understand that Brahma's day lasts a thousand ages, and his night the same.
verses.meaning: Krishna explains the vast scale of cosmic cycles.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्ताद्व्यक्तयः सर्वाः प्रभवन्त्यहरागमे | रात्र्यागमे प्रलीयन्ते तत्रैवाव्यक्तसंज्ञके ||
verses.transliteration: avyaktād vyaktayaḥ sarvāḥ prabhavanty ahar-āgame | rātry-āgame pralīyante tatraivāvyakta-saṃjñake ||
verses.english_translation: All manifest beings arise from the unmanifest at creation and dissolve back at dissolution.
verses.meaning: Creation and destruction are part of a continuous cycle.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते | रात्र्यागमेऽवशः पार्थ प्रभवत्यहरागमे ||
verses.transliteration: bhūta-grāmaḥ sa evāyaṃ bhūtvā bhūtvā pralīyate | rātry-āgame 'vaśaḥ pārtha prabhavaty ahar-āgame ||
verses.english_translation: All beings repeatedly come into existence and dissolve again.
verses.meaning: The cycle of birth and death continues endlessly.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: परस्तस्मात्तु भावोऽन्योऽव्यक्तोऽव्यक्तात्सनातनः | यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति ||
verses.transliteration: paras tasmāt tu bhāvo 'nyo 'vyakto 'vyaktāt sanātanaḥ | yaḥ sa sarveṣu bhūteṣu naśyatsu na vinaśyati ||
verses.english_translation: Beyond the unmanifest is another eternal reality that does not perish.
verses.meaning: There is a higher eternal truth beyond material existence.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तोऽक्षर इत्युक्तस्तमाहुः परमां गतिम् | यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम ||
verses.transliteration: avyakto 'kṣara ity uktas tam āhuḥ paramāṃ gatim | yaṃ prāpya na nivartante tad dhāma paramaṃ mama ||
verses.english_translation: This unmanifest eternal is the highest goal; reaching it, one does not return.
verses.meaning: Liberation leads to eternal union with the divine.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया | यस्यान्तःस्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ||
verses.transliteration: puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ pārtha bhaktyā labhyas tv ananyayā | yasyāntaḥsthāni bhūtāni yena sarvam idaṃ tatam ||
verses.english_translation: The supreme being is attained through pure devotion, who pervades everything.
verses.meaning: Devotion is the path to realizing the supreme.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यत्र काले त्वनावृत्तिमावृत्तिं चैव योगिनः | प्रयाता यान्ति तं कालं वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षभ ||
verses.transliteration: yatra kāle tv anāvṛttim āvṛttiṃ caiva yoginaḥ | prayātā yānti taṃ kālaṃ vakṣyāmi bharatarṣabha ||
verses.english_translation: I will explain the times at which yogis depart and either return or attain liberation.
verses.meaning: Time of death influences spiritual outcome.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अग्निर्ज्योतिरहः शुक्लः षण्मासा उत्तरायणम् | तत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदो जनाः ||
verses.transliteration: agnir jyotir ahaḥ śuklaḥ ṣaṇ-māsā uttarāyaṇam | tatra prayātā gacchanti brahma brahma-vido janāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Those who depart during light, day, and the northern path attain Brahman.
verses.meaning: Certain paths lead to liberation.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: धूमो रात्रिस्तथा कृष्णः षण्मासा दक्षिणायनम् | तत्र चान्द्रमसं ज्योतिर्योगी प्राप्य निवर्तते ||
verses.transliteration: dhūmo rātris tathā kṛṣṇaḥ ṣaṇ-māsā dakṣiṇāyanam | tatra cāndramasaṃ jyotir yogī prāpya nivartate ||
verses.english_translation: Those departing during darkness return again after reaching the lunar realm.
verses.meaning: Some paths lead to rebirth.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते | एकया यात्यनावृत्तिमन्ययावर्तते पुनः ||
verses.transliteration: śukla-kṛṣṇe gatī hy ete jagataḥ śāśvate mate | ekayā yāty anāvṛttim anyayāvartate punaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: There are two eternal paths: one leads to liberation, the other to rebirth.
verses.meaning: Choice of path determines destiny.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन | तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु योगयुक्तो भवार्जुन ||
verses.transliteration: naite sṛtī pārtha jānan yogī muhyati kaścana | tasmāt sarveṣu kāleṣu yoga-yukto bhavārjuna ||
verses.english_translation: Knowing these paths, the yogi is not deluded; therefore remain steadfast in yoga.
verses.meaning: Knowledge removes confusion and guides action.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: वेदेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैव दानेषु यत्पुण्यफलं प्रदिष्टम् | अत्येति तत्सर्वमिदं विदित्वा योगी परं स्थानमुपैति चाद्यम् ||
verses.transliteration: vedeṣu yajñeṣu tapaḥsu caiva dāneṣu yat puṇya-phalaṃ pradiṣṭam | atyeti tat sarvam idaṃ viditvā yogī paraṃ sthānam upaiti cādyam ||
verses.english_translation: The yogi transcends all merits gained from rituals and attains the supreme abode.
verses.meaning: True knowledge surpasses ritualistic rewards.
